messageAccessSQL: SELECT 1 FROM n_direct_conversations c JOIN n_direct_messages m ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.conversation_id = :conversation_id AND m.message_id = :message_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_deleted = :is_deleted AND (c.user_low_id = :user_id OR c.user_high_id = :user_id)
